st: 5 questions and answers, between Call of Duty and 69 billion

sec.t: 1️ ff.10.1 Will we really live only in another reality?
sec.p: This was the first question I was asked. In my view, the metaverse will be made up of two realities:

sec.t: 2️ ff.10.2 Are we already in the metaverse?
sec.p: But then again, aren't we already, a little, in the metaverse?

sec.t: 3️ ff.10.3 Will we only buy digital homes?
sec.p: I was also asked whether people will buy digital homes to live in. I think it's very possible. After all, some people are spending that kind of money on NFTs of an image.

sec.t: 4️ ff.10.4 Will we get paid to shoot?
sec.p: One thing that fascinates me about the metaverse is the possible integration of cryptocurrencies, or tokens, able to "pay back the nodes of the network itself". Each platform could give users a currency based on participation or performance, to motivate them and make them feel…

sec.t: 5️ ff.10.5 The world of video games: vanguard or stagnation?
sec.p: Microsoft's acquisition is truly crazy. 69 billion (more than half the company's cash) and it far exceeds what it paid for LinkedIn, Skype, Github and Nokia (combined).
